query:
SELECT 
  m.id as meeting_id,
  m.timeSlot,
  m.attendeeId,
  m.attendeeNumber,
  s.companyName as sponsor,
  CASE m.timeSlot
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Wed 10:15'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Wed 10:45'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed 11:00'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wed 11:30'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Wed 13:30'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Wed 14:00'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Thu 10:30'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'Thu 11:00'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Thu 13:15'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Thu 13:45'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'Thu 14:30'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu 15:00'
  END as slot_time
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId IN (
  -- Adam Binks
  SELECT id FROM (SELECT '93176107633' as id) x
  UNION SELECT '8196151'   -- Tush Wijeratne (approx)
  UNION SELECT '9477501'   -- Joanna Hackett (approx)
  UNION SELECT '8952301'   -- Mark Kunaseelan (approx)
  UNION SELECT '11132851'  -- Michelle Monahan (approx)
  UNION SELECT '110260566550' -- Lucy Bousfield (approx)
  UNION SELECT '113145184682' -- Jules Anderson (approx)
)
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
